content:
With every new iPhone release comes the rush to buy accessories, ensuring they arrive alongside your new device. This year, there's an entirely new category: the iPhone Duo. ESR, a highly regarded name in Apple accessories, has its iPhone 18 lineup ready, covering the all-new iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro models, and every accessory you might need: charging solutions, AirPods, Apple Watch, and even a MagSafe wallet. Here's a look at what ESR has prepared for Apple's newest iPhone series.

iPhone Duo Atelier Vegan Leather Case

The standout of the new iPhone series is ESR's Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand for the iPhone Duo. As we've seen with Android foldables, designing a case for a folding phone has always been a major challenge: it must protect both halves of the device, the hinge, and the outer screen, all without adding significant bulk. People buy the iPhone Duo precisely because it's thin and foldable, so ESR has created a premium case that truly fits modern, everyday carry.

The team started with look and feel, since that's what you notice first. The Atelier material uses premium organic silicone leather with a soft, smooth, skin-friendly touch. This high-end finish stays refined through everyday use rather than looking worn after a month. Some even say it gets better with age, like a fine wine. ESR has also added a stain-resistant coating and anti-stain treatment to the light-colored TPU surface, so it stands up to everyday spills and is easy to clean. ESR's tagline for this case is "For the Look That Lasts," combining premium feel with long-lasting durability.

The Flex Stand is another delightful feature of this everyday iPhone Duo case. Built from high-strength zinc alloy, it rotates 180 degrees with a precision hinge and tuned damping control for smooth, fluid movement. The internal damping lock holds steady at any angle whether folded or open, and the zinc alloy construction won't deform even with prolonged use, reliably supporting your iPhone Duo. ESR has put it through 30,000 open-and-close tests. Open for viewing, fold for protection. It's that simple.

Protection and magnetic strength make this iPhone Duo case equally compelling. Reinforced hinge protection, soft microfiber lining with TPU edges, and raised edge protection are all included. If you're a regular reader of MagSafe Monday, you'll know ESR has serious MagSafe chops (and the receipts to prove it): high-strength built-in magnets deliver 1,400g of magnetic force, holding securely to wireless chargers, car mounts, card holders, and power banks.

iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max Version of the Same Case

The Atelier case is also available for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, using the same premium materials as the iPhone Duo version. The back features premium organic silicone leather with a soft, smooth, skin-friendly touch that stays refined through everyday use. ESR has likewise added a stain-resistant coating and anti-stain treatment to the light-colored TPU surface, so everyday smudges wipe away easily without lingering. Spilled coffee? A quick wipe and it's gone. That's the heart of ESR's "For the Look That Lasts" philosophy.

The Flex Stand on the iPhone 18 and 18 Pro versions adjusts from 15 to 69 degrees, supporting both portrait and landscape viewing. Whether it's StandBy mode on your nightstand or watching a movie on a flight, it handles it effortlessly. Like the iPhone Duo version, it's a 2-in-1 design: open to view, fold to protect, no extra stand to carry.

On the protection front, the Pro version takes it further. It offers 3x military-grade protection, including 12-foot drop protection, plus a built-in Camera Control cover, soft microfiber lining with TPU edges to prevent edge scratches, and raised edge protection. Magnetic strength is again 1,400g, and the precise magnetic ring layout lets MagSafe accessories snap into alignment quickly, compatible with wireless chargers, car mounts, card holders, and power banks for comprehensive everyday carry.

UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector

For the ultimate in protection, the ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector fits both the iPhone Duo and the entire iPhone 18 Pro series. The Armorite Pro is ESR's line of tempered glass protectors, made with Accessory Glass by Corning, the same company that's been making durable glass for Apple products since the original iPhone.

In plain terms: this is genuinely strengthened glass, not ordinary tempered glass. ESR lab tests show it offers up to 10 times the impact resistance of common protectors found online and in retail stores.

Accessory Glass by Corning, based on Corning's own lab testing, also delivers up to 2x better scratch resistance and features an anti-reflective coating that cuts light reflection to just 2.3%, while maintaining 94% optical light transmittance. That means less glare, truer colors, and no compromise on display quality for the sake of protection.

Then there's installation, often the most error-prone and frustrating part of the process. A screen protector shouldn't require professional installation. We've all been there: line it up, lay it down, and discover a speck of dust trapped under the glass that you'll stare at for the next year. The ESR UltraFit Installation Tray is designed to solve exactly that. The whole system takes just two steps and one pull: place the tray on your phone, pull the strip, and the tray's design sweeps away dust and pushes out air bubbles as the protector lays down. On a brand-new iPhone Duo or iPhone 18 Pro, getting it right the first time matters, and the tray makes it effortless.

Cyclone 25W MagSafe Charger with CryoBoost

For MagSafe charging, the Cyclone 25W MagSafe Charger with CryoBoost charges your iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo while keeping temperatures down. Qi2 25W is the latest wireless charging standard, pushing magnetic charging speeds up to 25W, far beyond the 7.5W that MagSafe accessories have been stuck at for years, finally making wireless charging a serious option rather than the slow choice.

CryoBoost is ESR's proprietary active cooling technology: a built-in fan cools your phone during charging while operating at under 25 decibels. After weeks of use, the 9to5Mac team can confirm it's virtually silent. Cooling matters for more than just charging speed: heat degrades lithium battery health over time, so an actively cooled charger is an investment in your iPhone's long-term battery health, not just a faster fill today. These are benefits you'll appreciate two years from now, not two minutes from now.

It also features an adjustable stand with rotation from 0 to 150 degrees, handy at home or the office. You can follow a recipe in the kitchen while charging; angle it for StandBy mode on your nightstand before sleep; or go landscape for movie watching. On your desk, it doubles as a stand so you can check notifications and take FaceTime calls while charging. One device for the kitchen, nightstand, and desk, with no need for a different charger in every room. Promo code: MB078982.

On the charging front, there's also the ESR Xtend 45W Retractable Charger, a compact wall charger with a built-in retractable braided cable that extends to just over 3 feet, enough to charge comfortably without hugging the outlet. The braided cable has passed 20,000 pull/retract and 10,000 bend tests, built for everyday use rather than fraying after a few months. It supports the PD 3.2 AVS protocol with up to 60W dynamic output, enough to fast-charge a MacBook Air. ESR's internal testing shows it can charge an iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in 15 minutes. It also includes a second USB-C port for full coverage at home, the office, or on the go. Promo code: MJARV5BO.

ESR has also introduced the new Xtend 100W Retractable Car Charger, with independent 67W and 33W outputs to charge a laptop and phone simultaneously. ESR's internal testing shows the C1 cable delivers up to 67W, charging an iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in 15 minutes, or a MacBook Pro to 65% in 35 minutes. Both cables are built into the charger and retract fully when you're done, so there's no messy cable clutter in your car when not in use. A third USB-C port can charge another phone, earbuds, or a handheld gaming console at the same time. The built-in USB-C cable extends to just over 3 feet, with over-voltage/under-voltage protection and real-time temperature monitoring, keeping charging temperatures up to 15°C lower than typical car chargers. Promo code: ESR2B531.

AirPods, Apple Watch, and Wallet

Ever dropped your AirPods and watched them scatter? With the ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case, that's a thing of the past. FlickLock is ESR's patented sliding mechanism that toggles the internal magnets between attracting and repelling modes: locked at maximum strength when closed to prevent drops, and a quick flick opens it one-handed. It's the ultimate everyday carry AirPods case. Tested through 20,000 uses, MagSafe charging compatible, and available for AirPods Pro 3, Pro 2/1, and AirPods 5/4.

The ESR Equinox band combines a secure buckle design with breathable, skin-friendly materials, with a look that transitions easily from early-morning workouts to the boardroom. Compatible with Apple Watch Ultra 1-4 and Series 1-12. Finally, the ESR Armorite® Pro Protection Kit is designed for Apple Watch Ultra (1-4), using Accessory Glass by Corning with up to 2x better scratch resistance and 25% less visible scratching, with quick installation for both the screen protector and case, no band removal required.

To round out your new iPhone accessory ecosystem, the ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand is the first MagSafe wallet with full Apple-certified Find My support, now with Siri voice search added; when you misplace the wallet somewhere, you can just ask Siri to find it. It holds 5 cards, features a transparent driver's license window, RFID blocking, and a finger loop grip, plus doubles as a multi-angle iPhone stand. If you're looking for a MagSafe wallet for everyday carry with your new iPhone, this creative pick is the one for you.

Wrap-up

Apple has ushered in a new era with the iPhone Duo alongside an excellent iPhone 18 lineup. Each fall's new iPhone launch is only half the story; what truly shapes your daily experience are the accessories, and the iPhone Duo makes choosing the right ones even more critical. It's not just about picking the right case. ESR's accessory ecosystem keeps your iPhone and AirPods charged at home and on the go, while fully protecting your devices from everyday wear and tear.

ESR has built its new iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 series accessories around exactly that need: trusted protection, faster and cooler charging, and versatile everyday carry gear. The new iPhones are here, and ESR is ready to complete the picture. Follow ESR on X and Facebook to stay up to date on the latest products.
